chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى أَبَانٌ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ قَالَ:

translations.en: Aban narrated from Isma'il, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ ٱسْتَأْجَرَ مِنْ رَجُلٍ أَرْضًا فَقَالَ آجِرْنِيهَا بِكَذَا وَ كَذَا إِنْ زَرَعْتُهَا أَوْ لَمْ أَزْرَعْهَا أُعْطِيكَ ذَلِكَ فَلَمْ يَزْرَعِ ٱلرَّجُلُ

translations.en: I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who rented land from another man and said: "Lease it to me for such-and-such, whether I cultivate it or I do not cultivate it, I will give you that." Then the man did not cultivate it.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ لَهُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَهُ بِمَالِهِ إِنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَتْرُكْ.

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "He has the right to take it with its payment. If he wishes, he may leave it, and if he wishes, he may not leave it."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on leasing agricultural land when the lessee agrees to pay a fixed amount whether or not he cultivates it. If the agreement was made on those terms, the lessor is entitled to the payment, though he may choose to forgo it.
en.seo_question: If someone rents farmland for a fixed payment whether he cultivates it or not, is the rent still due if he leaves it uncultivated?

key_terms.ٱسْتَأْجَرَ: entered into a lease or rental agreement
key_terms.أُعْطِيكَ: I will pay or give you
key_terms.بِمَالِهِ: for its agreed payment or financial due
